message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts.

Facts: Li was drunk driving (blood alcohol 136.55 mg/100ml). That's over 80 mg/100ml, so it's drunk driving. In Chinese law, "危险驾驶罪" (dangerous driving) includes drunk driving. So crime: 危险驾驶.

Also, Li had prior conviction for "过失损坏军事通信罪" (negligent damage to military communications) and was under a probation period (考验期). He committed a new crime during probation, which may be "再犯" leading to "考验期内再犯新罪". That may affect sentencing but not a separate crime. The new crime is drunk driving. Also, maybe "拒不执行判决、裁定" not applicable. No other crimes.

Thus answer: 危险驾驶.
